description: This is a test class for the EmployeeAPI in the OrangeHRM project, specifically for API endpoint testing related to Employee operations like get, create, delete, etc. It defines various test methods that interact with the EmployeeAPI class and use fixtures and mock services to verify API behavior.

classes.name: EmployeeAPITest
classes.description: Test suite for the EmployeeAPI endpoints related to Employee management in OrangeHRM, including CRUD operations and retrieval of employee data.

methods.name: testGetEmployeePictureService
methods.description: Tests that the EmployeeAPI correctly returns an instance of EmployeePictureService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a single employee record using the API.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all employee records using the API.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new employee record through the API.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that the update operation is not implemented and correctly throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that getValidationRuleForUpdate is not implemented and throws an exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting an employee record via the API.
